affirmations: I am allowed to take up the space I actually occupy.
I do not have to earn my own kindness.
The pace I am moving at is a real pace.
I can change my mind without betraying who I was.
What I want is information, not a character flaw.
I am permitted to rest before I have finished.
My body is not a problem to be managed today.
I can be a beginner in public.
I do not owe anyone an explanation for a boundary.
Something is working that I cannot see yet.
I am allowed to want more than this and still be grateful.
The discomfort of growth is not the same as the pain of harm.
I can hold two true things at once.
I return to myself as many times as it takes.
I am not behind. There is no line.
I can let this be easy.
What I tolerate, I teach. Today I am teaching something new.
I have survived every day that came before this one.
My softness is not a security failure.
I choose the version of this story that lets me move.
I am allowed to be proud of something small.
Peace is a practice, not a personality.
